description: Compact 4-layer STM32F042 automotive/industrial CAN bus IMU sensor node. Powered via USB-C (5V) stepped down to 3.3V via LDO (TLV1117-33), featuring an STM32F042K6Tx Cortex-M0 MCU with external 8 MHz active oscillator, an ASM330LHHXTR 6-axis IMU over SPI, a TJA1051T-3 CAN transceiver with selectable 120-ohm termination and bus headers, plus SWD and dual UART interfaces.

power_rails.notes: USB-C VBUS and external header 5V rail feeding U4 LDO

differential_pairs.name: CAN_BUS
differential_pairs.notes: CAN 2.0B / CAN-FD differential bus between TJA1051T-3 (U1), 120-ohm termination (R2/J11), and bus headers (J12/J13)

design_requirements.decoupling_guidance: Place 100nF/1uF/10uF/100uF bypass capacitors (C1..C12) tightly adjacent to the VDD pins of U2 (STM32F042), U3 (ASM330LHHXTR), U1 (TJA1051T-3), U4 (TLV1117-33), and Y1 (8 MHz oscillator).
